name: Portfolio
description: This project is deployed on **Netlify** : https://nicoboga.netlify.app

scripts.uglifyjs: for file in js/*.js; do terser "$file" --compress --mangle --output "js/$(basename "$file")"; done
scripts.obfuscate: javascript-obfuscator js/ --output js/ --compact true --control-flow-flattening true --self-defending true
scripts.list-gitignore: bash -c "shopt -s nullglob; echo gitignore/*.gitignore | tr ' ' '\n' | grep --color=always 'gitignore/~.gitignore\|$'"
scripts.concat-gitignore: bash -c "for file in gitignore/*.gitignore; do echo;cat \"\$file\"; done > .gitignore"
scripts.set-version: bash -c "arg=${1:-}; if [[ $arg =~ ^(patch|minor|major)$ ]]; then npm version $arg --no-git-tag-version > /dev/null; elif [[ -n $arg ]]; then npm version $arg --no-git-tag-version > /dev/null; else echo 'Please provide a version or patch/minor/major'; exit 1; fi; echo $(node -p \"require('./package.json').version\")" --
scripts.tag-version: bash -c "version=$(node -p \"require('./package.json').version\"); if git status --porcelain | grep -vE '^.M (package.json|CHANGELOG.md)' | grep -q .; then echo 'Uncommitted or unstaged changes detected. Please commit or stash your changes before tagging.'; else git tag v$version; echo 'v'$version; fi" --
scripts.fix-version-commit: bash -c "level=${1:-patch}; CURRENT_VERSION=$(node -p \"require('./package.json').version\"); LAST_TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo '0.0.0'); if [[ \"$CURRENT_VERSION\" == \"$LAST_TAG\" ]]; then echo 'Version and changelog already at latest tag $LAST_TAG, nothing to fix.'; else UPSTREAM=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name @{u} 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if [[ -n \"$UPSTREAM\" ]] && git merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD \"$UPSTREAM\"; then npm version $level --no-git-tag-version > /dev/null; git add package.json; PREV_MSG=$(git log -1 --pretty=%B); git reset --soft HEAD~1; git commit -m \"$PREV_MSG\"; NEW_VERSION=$(node -p \"require('./package.json').version\"); git tag -f v$NEW_VERSION; npm run changelog; git add CHANGELOG.md; git commit --amend --no-edit; git tag -f v$NEW_VERSION; git push --force; git push --tags --force; else npm version $level --no-git-tag-version > /dev/null; git add package.json; git commit --amend --no-edit; NEW_VERSION=$(node -p \"require('./package.json').version\"); git tag -f v$NEW_VERSION; npm run; git add CHANGELOG.md; git commit --amend --no-edit; git tag -f v$NEW_VERSION; fi; fi" --
scripts.release-local: bash -c "level=${1:-patch}; if [[ $level =~ ^(patch|minor|major)$ ]]; then npm version $level --no-git-tag-version > /dev/null; elif [[ $level =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then npm version $level --no-git-tag-version > /dev/null; else echo \"Version invalide: $level\"; exit 1; fi; git add package.json; git commit --amend --no-edit; version=$(node -p \"require('./package.json').version\"); git tag -f v$version; npm run changelog; git add CHANGELOG.md; git commit --amend --no-edit; git tag -f v$version" _
scripts.push-all: bash -c "if [ \"$1\" = \"force\" ]; then git push --force && git push --tags --force; else git push && git push --tags; fi" --
scripts.release-remote: bash -c "level=${1:-patch}; npm run release-local --silent -- $level && npm run push-all -- force" --
